title: Oil is Up But Gold Won't Fall the Dollar Won't Rally. What Gives?
speaker: Ilya Spivak (tastylive head of global macro)

macro_themes.view: Bonds rising, gold holding and dollar weak despite surging oil and hot CPI/PPI suggest markets see a growth risk.
Beige Book shows pain spreading to middle-income households; wages lag CPI, confidence near record lows, GDPNow trending lower.

macro_themes.theme: Hikes may come off the board
macro_themes.view: If PMIs disappoint and earnings don't excite, priced-in 2027 rate hikes will be removed.
Favours Mexico and Brazil equities on regionalization theme.

calls.condition: A break of the current shelf would confirm a top
calls.reason: Lower highs/lower lows on the 8-hour; bounce looks like a retracement within a decline, retesting broken range support as resistance.
calls.quote: we're flirting with what could be the formation of a top. It's not confirmed for now

calls.reason: Soggy rebound turning back exactly at the broken former range support.
calls.quote: just where you might think would be the line in the sand is where the market turns back

calls.reason: Gold refusing to sell off despite oil surge and hot inflation hints at a growth scare and fewer hikes.

calls.instrument_quoted: FX crosses (AUD, GBP, EUR, CAD vs USD)
calls.reason: Long USD vs AUD, GBP, EUR but added short USD vs CAD, while describing the dollar as unusually weak.
calls.quote: short the Aussie, the pound, and the euro. So, long the dollar here

calls.condition: If PMIs/earnings disappoint, hikes come off and yields keep falling
calls.reason: Yields have retreated all month as breakevens stop following oil; growth scare.
calls.quote: some of these rate hikes are going to have to come off the board

calls.reason: Exploratory call vertical as Mexico ETF tries to break out; regionalization theme.
calls.quote: I've got a little exploratory call vertical on EWW... It seems to be trying to break out

calls.reason: Held since early 2025 on deglobalization/regionalization thesis.
calls.quote: the one that's had me holding EWZ, the Brazilian uh ETF since early 2025

notes: Speaker name garbled ('Uisback'); assumed Ilya Spivak. Dated Monday 2026-10-19 from context (SpaceX earnings 'tomorrow', Tesla Wednesday, housing data tomorrow). DXY positioning mixed (long USD vs AUD/GBP/EUR, short vs CAD). Transcript cut off at 18:00.
